items.title: Chennai woman dies in waterlogged pit, authorities wash hands off as kin seek answers
items.summary: Follow TNM’s WhatsApp channel for news updates and story links. Around 9.30 pm on Sunday, August 23, Sangeetha got a call from her mother M Kalavathi. “I’ll be late getting home, you have dinner and go to sleep,” she told her. Earlier in the evening, Kalavathi had stepped out of their house in Padi Puthunagar of Chennai’s Anna Nagar West Extension to go to church. Less than two hours later, around 11.20 pm, Sangeetha’s phone rang again. This time, it was the Ayanavaram police calling to ask her to identify the photo of a woman they had found unconscious in a rainwater-filled pit. She had “fainted”, Sangeetha was told. That woman, who was later declared dead at the Kilpauk Medical College Hospital (KMCH), was Kalavathi. Passersby had found the 59-year-old woman unconscious in a pit near the Anna Nagar Tower Metro station in Chennai and alerted the police. With the help of the public, they pulled her out and took her to KMCH, where doctors declared her brought dead.
